items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Jack O'Toole played drums. He played in different bands. He was in the band instrument department. ... Jack was about two years older than I.

ctx.x: Eddie Miller was in the band instrument department in the Whirlines, in the band instrument repair department. I remember him just as plain as day. Jack O'Toole played drums. He played in different bands. He was in the band instrument department. Jack O'Toole, I just learned, died not too long ago. He was in Shreveport. Hmm. Jack was about two years older than I.
